kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
أتضامن (form VI)
# أَتَضَامَنُ (ʔataḍāmanu) /ʔa.ta.dˤaː.ma.nu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of تَضَامَنَ (taḍāmana)
# أَتَضَامَنَ (ʔataḍāmana) /ʔa.ta.dˤaː.ma.na/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of تَضَامَنَ (taḍāmana)
# أَتَضَامَنْ (ʔataḍāman) /ʔa.ta.dˤaː.man/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of تَضَامَنَ (taḍāmana)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
